<thought>By recognizing that the measured resistances from A and B to all intermediate nodes sum to the total A‑B resistance of 140 Ω, the circuit is a simple series chain. The cumulative resistances match a sequence of resistors: R1=5 Ω, R2=10 Ω, R3=15 Ω, R4=30 Ω, R5=15 Ω, R6=30 Ω, R7=15 Ω, R8=20 Ω. Nodes X1 and X2 lie inside R4 and R6 respectively, splitting those resistors into two parts each (R4a=20 Ω, R4b=10 Ω; R6a=20 Ω, R6b=10 Ω). This topology reproduces every given node‑to‑node resistance.</thought>
